notes.note: Reviewed the final Dockerfile-command fixture against the temp-dir ratchet: homes are now registered with trackTempDirs at collection time and remain under this worktree via a relative prefix. Its afterEach cleanup runs even on assertion failure, after the function has signaled the PID/birth-verified supervisor and reaped real detached lifecycle children. This changes test resource ownership only, not service startup, schema admission, policy preservation, claim refusal or wait semantics.
